properties.description:
Local density rung. Drives the same `--md-sys-density-scale` signal that a
global `data-density` ancestor sets, so a local value simply overrides the
inherited one. 0 = default, -4 = ultra-compact.

name: Icon Button
description: A common action expressed as an icon alone. Four emphasis styles, five sizes, three container widths, round/square shape with shape morphing, and an optional toggle mode with a distinct selected glyph.

notes: Dedicated SwiftUI icon-button implements the source 5 sizes, 3 widths and 5 density rungs, 4 variant palettes including toggle/selected/disabled precedence, bundled Material Symbols, shape morphing and logical connected corners. It shares the tested native focus/responder and pointer-origin ripple infrastructure with md-button.

Default/selected named children obey meaningful-content fallback: raw whitespace and md-badge do not mask the icon prop; AWCNode.slotText creates an authored element-like wrapper, including an explicit empty wrapper, and AWCNode.symbol uses the real Material font. Selected glyphs swap only in selected toggle mode; selected palette/morph also applies without toggle. Avatar children retain their own size; badge adornments anchor to the physical top-right of the icon wrapper and may overflow the host.

AWCIconButtonAction preserves source navigation, then toggle commit, then mdClick({selected}) ordering. The event supports native scoped capture/target/bubble and cancellation metadata, but canceling this post-action notification cannot undo navigation or selection. There is no mdChange, source imperative method, or form-submit behavior. Native activation.source identifies pointer, keyboard, accessibility or unknown entry.

Enter/Space activate on keydown with a 150ms press pulse; pointer press holds until release/cancel. Hard-disabled excludes focus; soft-disabled remains focusable and inert. groupTabindex implements ordinary/null, 0 and -1 native focus semantics. Positive browser tabindex ordering is not emulated. aria-label supplies the authored native accessible name; decorative Material glyph names are not spoken. Source role remains button even when href is present.

Target is supplied to AWCURLRouter; AWCNavigationCoordinator can provide explicit self/blank/parent/top/named native presentation contexts. It does not create browser windows, opener/referrer behavior or DOM events. Relative routes require a host base URL. The default SwiftUI openURL fallback delegates presentation to the app.

Nine public visual hooks map to validated AWCIconButtonAppearance values inherited fieldwise through View.awcIconButtonAppearance. All three CSS parts have measured native visual counterparts; arbitrary CSS selectors and CSS execution remain Web APIs. Corner radius overrides resting shape, while selected/pressed morph targets and connected corner precedence follow the source.

Actual NSHostingView geometry, palette pixels, slot updates, pointer, keyboard, native focus and accessibility are covered by a checked-in test runner. macOS SwiftUI library/live/snapshot products compile and run. This environment has Command Line Tools only; iOS SDK/device/VoiceOver execution is unverified. See audits/md-icon-button.md.

Dedicated Compose renderer implements all 19 source properties, all five size and density rungs, narrow/default/wide widths, four source palettes, selected/pressed/resting morph precedence, connected logical corners, pointer-origin ripple, keyboard focus and native group coordination. Default/selected slots replace glyph fallbacks; direct native badges adorn without suppressing the icon and avatars retain their own dimensions. Navigation and toggle commit before cancelable mdClick notification, exactly as the source does; no mdChange is emitted. The nine public CSS hooks map to AWCIconButtonAppearance. Native layout evidence covers the visual root, state-layer and active icon part. Source DOM objects, CSS selector evaluation, browser windows and forced-colors media queries remain platform-specific.

SHADOW_DOM.description: Default and selected composable slots replace source glyphs. Direct native badges and avatars preserve their source slot sizing roles.
limitations: Native composition replaces shadow DOM; arbitrary DOM inspection is not exposed.

DOM_QUERY.description: Native slot lookup and injected application routing replace the component-specific DOM queries.
limitations: No arbitrary CSS selector engine or browser window is created.

SLOT_INTROSPECTION.description: Subcomposition detects actual child layout and selects the default or selected icon layer; badges do not count as replacement icons. Explicit Text composables, including empty editor text, represent authored replacement elements.
limitations: Compose children replace DOM nodes; omission restores fallback while an authored empty element suppresses it.

DOM_GLOBAL.description: Safe relative links resolve against the source native context current URL. Observable native contexts implement self, blank, parent, top and reusable named destinations, independent history, back and subtree close. A host can reject navigation before commit and present accepted destinations after commit. Unsafe raw links never fall through to form actions.
limitations: Contexts are native application state, not browser windows, documents, origins or opener relationships; no page is fetched by the coordinator.

Named native destinations are deliberately reusable; source window.open with noopener/noreferrer may instead create fresh browser contexts. Browser modifier/middle-click navigation and window APIs are not reproduced.
URLs must parse as native URIs. Applications supply presentation for coordinator destinations; the legacy default router still opens absolute Android URIs.

CANCELABLE_EVENT.description: Scoped native capture/target/bubble delivery exposes cancelable mdClick after safe navigation and selection have already committed, matching the source icon-button ordering.
limitations: Calling preventDefault marks the notification but cannot undo effects that preceded it. OS input and DOM propagation are not fabricated.
